suite_name: EduTrack QR API Fault Injection & Fuzzing Assessment

test_cases.expected_behavior: Input sanitized or rejected before RegExp compilation
test_cases.observed_behavior_v0: Server single-thread event loop blocks at 100% CPU when executed with 25+ repetitions

test_cases.expected_behavior: Graceful 400 Bad Request with standardized error message
test_cases.observed_behavior_v0: Mongoose CastError triggers global unhandled error handler emitting raw stack trace

test_cases.input_payload: JSON array containing 50,000 synthetic student items
test_cases.expected_behavior: Enforce strict batch array limit (e.g. max 100 entries per request)
test_cases.observed_behavior_v0: Server attempts to construct 50,000 bulkWrite operations, leading to heap memory bloat and connection timeout

test_cases.expected_behavior: Strict schema validation whitelisting only defined fields (Zod/Joi)
test_cases.observed_behavior_v0: Mongoose rejects __proto__ by default (mitigated), but accepts arbitrary unexpected schema keys via req.body

test_cases.expected_behavior: Magic byte file signature inspection & image re-encoding
test_cases.observed_behavior_v0: Upload middleware inspects only client header and file extension, saving payload to /backend/uploads/
